entries.construct_consequence: No record asserts R7 vocabulary-owner identity or formal delegation.
entries.failure: Provider/indexer custody is not R7-owner custody
entries.next_discriminator: A content-addressed delegation and completed algebra signed by the R7 owner.
entries.observed_evidence: Europe PMC and PubMed expose structured publication/link metadata for 11,991 comparable notices.

entries.construct_consequence: Tokens such as RetractionOf or ErratumFor do not enumerate the licensed or forbidden R7 operations.
entries.failure: Relation/link semantics are not operation semantics
entries.next_discriminator: Owner-approved per-target operation sets, including exhaustive forbidden sets.
entries.observed_evidence: JATS describes an outward-facing link and PubMed RefType names bibliographic relationships.

entries.construct_consequence: High metadata conformance still does not yield KEEP/REPAIR/REFORMULATE/UNRESOLVED terminals.
entries.failure: Directionality is not a target decision
entries.next_discriminator: An explicit owner-approved bridge from source relation evidence to target decisions, or explicit NONE.
entries.observed_evidence: The normalized relation sets agree for 11,988 of 11,991 notices while preserving Of/In and forward/backward direction.

entries.construct_consequence: The seven target profiles and operation sets cannot be assumed exhaustive.
entries.next_discriminator: Signed closed_world=true plus exhaustive=true for each target.
entries.observed_evidence: Both providers omit some relation identifiers and the protocol treats all absence as CANNOT_CHECK.

entries.construct_consequence: Metadata cannot authorize Orion to recommend a postpublication action.
entries.next_discriminator: Joint vocabulary-owner and host-authority approval per target.
entries.observed_evidence: No allowlisted structured field carries advisory or owner-ratified recommendation authority.

entries.construct_consequence: No execution, adoption, promotion, or merge may follow.
entries.next_discriminator: Host owner assigns NONE, EXTERNAL_OWNER_ONLY, or SYSTEM and signs it.
entries.observed_evidence: Structured metadata records publication events but no system authority boundary.

entries.construct_consequence: Fail-closed behavior for the R7 adapter remains unbound.
entries.next_discriminator: One owner-approved terminal for every non-success condition.
entries.observed_evidence: No provider field maps abstention, error, timeout, malformed, or unsupported inputs.

entries.construct_consequence: Authenticity, delegation, artifact identity, and timestamp cannot be verified.
entries.next_discriminator: Owner signature bundle with artifact digest and delegation basis.
entries.observed_evidence: Provider records and vocabulary documents contain no signature bundle over the target algebra.

entries.next_discriminator: Independent reviewer with no algebra authorship or case-outcome custody issues CONFORMANT receipt.
entries.observed_evidence: Europe PMC/PubMed agreement is metadata conformance between related indexing interfaces, not a review of the R7 algebra.

entries.construct_consequence: Those licences do not publish or license the target algebra itself.
entries.failure: Item rights are not target-algebra rights
entries.next_discriminator: Rights-holder archive URL, SPDX identifier, and licence-text hash for the completed algebra.
entries.observed_evidence: 12,038 relations in 11,602 families have exact allowlisted licences at both article endpoints.

entries.construct_consequence: A raw or even normalized publication-type equality claim would overstate interface equivalence.
entries.next_discriminator: Treat PubMed PublicationType and Europe PMC semantic overlays as separate strata, or obtain provider documentation explicitly binding the overlay.
entries.observed_evidence: After excluding 739 records with frozen lowercase JATS/PMC additions, only 740/11,991 publication-type sets match; every remaining mismatch is the Europe-PMC-only controlled token Retraction of Publication on 11,251 records.

entries.construct_consequence: Provider relation completeness cannot be inferred from near-perfect agreement.
entries.failure: Three normalized relation sets still differ
entries.next_discriminator: Provider-native provenance/refresh receipts or record-owner attestation for the three residual interfaces.
entries.observed_evidence: 11,988/11,991 normalized relation sets match; one has EPMC-only Preprint in and two have PubMed-only RetractionOf.

entries.construct_consequence: Unknown or absent structured values cannot be forced into a scientific action.
entries.failure: Fifteen notice records remain outside the frozen action strata
entries.next_discriminator: An owner-approved additional structured token or explicit unsupported terminal.
entries.observed_evidence: 11,976/11,991 records classify into exactly one stratum; 15 are OTHER_OR_CANNOT_CHECK and zero are ambiguous.

entries.construct_consequence: The pool proves three-stratum feasibility but not balanced sampling, natural prevalence of R7 decisions, or transport.
entries.failure: The public structured pool is highly retraction-dominant
entries.next_discriminator: Prospectively stratified design with independent scientific-action adjudication and explicit estimand weighting.
entries.observed_evidence: Record counts are 11,251 retraction, 256 correction/erratum, and 469 expression of concern.

summary.rule: Every open failure is a research target; none may be converted to a positive scientific claim without its discriminator.
